source_reference: 2021-02-08 article explicitly attributes its dividend-stock selection criteria to the exact 박곰희TV video ID

analysis.core: High dividend yield alone is not a sufficient selection rule. Distinguish mature profitable firms, stable owner-led niche firms, and apparent high-yield cases caused by price collapse or one-off payouts. For beginners, the preserved criteria are to avoid very small firms, verify a multi-year record of stable or rising dividends, and inspect revenue, operating profit and net income for stability.
quantitative: historical beginner screen: market capitalization below KRW 100 billion excluded
check roughly three years of dividend continuity
cautions: market-cap threshold is a heuristic from the historical video, not a universal valuation rule
dividends are discretionary and can be reduced or omitted
a high dividend yield may reflect falling share price or one-off distributions
